title: Inception
plot: A skilled thief who steals secrets by entering people's dreams is offered a chance to erase his record by planting an idea in a target's mind, a task called inception.

title: The Matrix
plot: A hacker learns that reality is a simulation created by machines and joins a rebellion to free humanity from the illusion.

title: The Italian Job
plot: A crew executes an audacious gold heist in Turin, using a traffic jam and three Mini Cooper cars to escape.

title: The Italian Job
plot: After a betrayal, a team of thieves plans an elaborate gold heist in Los Angeles, again using Mini Cooper cars to slip through the city.

title: Ocean's Eleven
plot: A recently paroled con man assembles a team of eleven specialists to rob three Las Vegas casinos on the same night.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
plot: A banker wrongly convicted of murder forms a friendship in prison and quietly works toward an escape over many years.

title: Toy Story
plot: A cowboy doll feels threatened when a flashy new spaceman toy arrives, and the rivals must work together to find their way home.

title: Finding Nemo
plot: A timid clownfish crosses the ocean to rescue his son, who has been captured and placed in a dentist's aquarium.

title: Jurassic Park
plot: Scientists clone dinosaurs for a theme park, but the animals break loose when the park's security fails.

title: The Dark Knight
plot: A masked vigilante confronts an anarchic criminal who plunges the city into chaos and forces impossible moral choices.

title: Titanic
plot: A poor artist and a wealthy young woman fall in love aboard the doomed ocean liner on its first and final voyage.

title: Blade Runner
plot: A weary detective hunts fugitive bioengineered humans called replicants in a rain-soaked future Los Angeles.

title: Interstellar
plot: As Earth becomes unlivable, a former pilot leads a mission through a wormhole to find a new home for humanity.

title: The Godfather
plot: The reluctant youngest son of a crime family is drawn into the business and gradually becomes its ruthless leader.

title: Spirited Away
plot: A young girl wanders into a spirit world and must work in a bathhouse to free her parents and find her way back.

title: Parasite
plot: A poor family schemes to be employed by a wealthy household, until a hidden secret upends the arrangement.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
plot: In a desert wasteland, a drifter and a rebel commander flee a tyrant across the sands in a relentless vehicle chase.

title: Coco
plot: A boy who dreams of music is transported to the Land of the Dead, where he seeks a famous ancestor and his family's blessing.
